description.value: The Japanese Garden is a tranquil ornamental garden located within Polson Park in Vernon, BC. Polson Park is a large municipal park in the heart of the city and is a popular stop for visitors passing through the Okanagan. The Japanese Garden forms a scenic centrepiece within the park grounds.
